course.title: Urban and Regional Economics
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: Suppose a person have two income options (per month): to earn \$75 US from home-based freelancing and working at an office for \$140 US (ignore social cost). If one way transportation to office costs \$0.25 US/km and the office is at 5km from home and considering 25 days a month office days, explain his/her decision to accept employment between the two.
Also explain, how will his/her decision will change in the following conditions: (i) Suppose the office offers transportation cost \$30 US per month (ignore time cost);
(ii) Suppose it takes 1hr to reach office and time cost is \$ .10 US/hr

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2015
